authorship: independent automated research worker; no human domain review
freezeCommit: Controller registry records the immutable freeze commit; no self-referential commit hash
model: Conservative convex combination in ladder/log-GDP space; selected 75% persistence + 25% own-country damped OLS trend

internalValidation.selectionMetric: equal mean of three cell MAEs; not pooled

limits: The original aggregate miss and the brief's structural hypothesis were known before this recipe. Revised 2026-vintage 2015–2018 data are not a 2018 information archive. No blinded independent confirmation or deployable historical forecast is claimed.

Only two origins and horizons 1–2 can be checked. Countries and targets repeat across cells; this is temporal validation for the same countries, not independent-country evidence. No observed seven-year validation is available inside four years. Candidate selection itself is optimistic.
No guaranteed improvement, significance claim, causal claim or AI/UBI validation. Best-of-five selection is exploratory. Persistence winning internal selection is a legitimate entry.
